_comment: Egg exported by Waifly - custom NodeJS Universal runtime, self-built images, public.
name: NodeJS Universal (Waifly)
author: a.devogelaere@siweb.fr
description:
Generic Node.js egg using Waifly's own self-built images (ghcr.io/waiflyhost/nodejs), rebuilt regularly to track the latest minor/patch releases instead of depending on a third-party image maintainer. Public, no authentication needed to pull.

Clones a Git repo (or use USER_UPLOAD if you upload files yourself), installs node_modules, then runs the app with node or ts-node.

Source: https://github.com/WaiflyHost/pterodactyl-eggs
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [[ ! -z ${UNNODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then npm uninstall ${UNNODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [ -f /home/container/package.json ]; then npm install; fi; if [[ "${MAIN_FILE}" == *.ts ]]; then ts-node --esm "/home/container/${MAIN_FILE}" ${NODE_ARGS}; else node "/home/container/${MAIN_FILE}" ${NODE_ARGS}; fi

config.startup: {"done":["change this text to something your app prints once it is ready"]}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# NodeJS App Installation Script (Waifly)
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
apt update
apt install -y git curl unzip ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "USER_UPLOAD is set, skipping git clone. Upload your files manually."
    exit 0
fi

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "using anonymous git access"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo -e "/mnt/server is not empty"
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
    fi
    if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        echo -e "pulling latest from git"
        git pull
    fi
else
    echo -e "/mnt/server is empty, cloning repo"
    if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi

echo "Installing npm packages"
if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then
    npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    npm install --production
fi

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: GitHub/GitLab repo to clone, e.g. https://github.com/user/repo

variables.name: Install Branch
variables.description: The branch to install. Leave empty for the default branch.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description:
Skip the git clone if you are uploading files yourself.
0 = false (default), 1 = true

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest files from git on every startup.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username to authenticate with git (optional, for private repos).

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal access token to authenticate with git (optional, for private repos).

variables.name: Additional NPM packages
variables.description: Additional npm packages to install, space separated.

variables.name: Uninstall NPM packages
variables.description: NPM packages to uninstall, space separated.

variables.name: Main file
variables.description: The file that starts the app. Can be .js or .ts

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Any extra arguments passed to node/ts-node.
